questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: there was two days were you should registere to ass many courses possible, and then the seats would be assigned randomely, so sometime you would have too many credits and some times tou would have two few. the first two weeks you would then be able to attend as many classes as possible also those you did not get registered to, and then you had to ask the professor if there was room in their class and if you could get a code for that class. you also had to deregister classes here.
